rule: Women the king lists hold as rulers. A queen-cued museum mention may resolve to one of them, by any name the king authority gives her (a leading 'Queen'/'(Queen)' dropped); king_name must resolve to exactly one king. Where D&H also has her (dh_id), the D&H woman is the same individual (README, 'Cross-source duplicates with pharaoh.se'), and a mention that lands on that entry resolves to the king. Neferneferuaten is left out: whether that king was Nefertiti or Meryetaten is disputed.
